author: yungmuck
body: I was wrongly accused of cross teaming and got banned for no reason by Mod Alarmclock. Me (Muckdog11) and Crookthekid we going for the same chest and i agree we should have fought but i had no weapon so we walked away and i went to make a weapon so we could then fight but as i began making a weapon i was wrongfully kicked and i would like it to please be dealt with my name is Muckdog11 if u have any questions contact me directly
